content:
The HWPX generation failed because the 'High (즉시조치)' severity string was missing from the combined XML sections of the output document.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present. Specifically, 'High (즉시조치)' was not found in the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While 3 tests passed, the failure indicates that the mapping of risk levels to their Korean severity labels in the HWPX XML structure is incorrect or missing. Avoid omitting the parenthetical severity suffix when populating the '위험등급' field in the XML templates.
